verdict.rationale: Self-hosted docs mention per-user API keys and a request audit log, which gives some access control and auditability, but there is no evidence of roles, granular read/write policies, or access-control lists governing who/what can access memory. missing for 10: role-based access control, granular read/write permission policies, ACL management, platform-side (not just self-hosted) audit/governance tooling.
